summary: Decode authorized assistant principals as typed timeline message senders

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery changes.

schema.detail: No stored schema changes. The client v0 wire schema adds SenderRef for TimelineMessageBody.from, accepting assistant principals alongside existing agent, person and step senders.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Regenerated TypeScript models and decoders accept assistant/chatgpt as a timeline sender. ParticipantRef recipients and ActorRef actors remain unchanged and reject assistants. Rust and Swift retain their existing string representation.

manual.detail: No operator actions or re-pairing required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state or rollback changes.
